description: Register a JSON Schema Kaval extracts structured records against. Bind the returned schema's id to a source with update_source so every document that lands on it afterward is extracted automatically and delivered as an extraction.document webhook, or pass it directly to create_extraction_run for a one-off publisher + period run. This is the schema-bound successor to list_bulletins' free-text extraction. Requires policy-update:manage.

idempotency_key.description: reuse the operation key returned by an ambiguous prior attempt; omit for a new operation

json_schema.description: the JSON Schema records must satisfy, e.g. {type:'object', properties:{cpt_code:{type:'string'}}, required:['cpt_code']}

name: create_extraction_schema
